test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following cities lies on the bank of the river Gomti?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh, lies on the bank of the river Gomti.**
 
• Besides Lucknow, other towns located on its banks are **Lakhimpur Kheri, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur.**
 
• The Gomti river provides drinking water to these cities.
 
• Gomti__
 __
 
• The Gomti, a monsoon- and groundwater-fed river, have its origin at Gomat Taal (earlier known as Fulhaar jheel) near Madho Tanda, Pilibhit, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The river is a** left tributary of the Ganga **and is one of **India's transcendental rivers**.
 
• ​The Gomati River flows through an incised valley southwards.
 
• The river flows through the districts of **Sitapur, Lucknow, Barabanki, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur.**
 
• The river cuts the Sultanpur district and Jaunpur in half.
 
• The Gomati River travels **950 km before meeting the river Ganga. **​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhopal is not located on the banks of any river. **

 
 
• It is known as the City of Lakes and is surrounded by the Upper and Lower lakes.
 
 
 
• **Aligarh**
 
 
• **​**It lies at the southern edge of the Upper **Ganges-Yamuna Doab.**
 
• It is famous for its** brass hardware and sculpture**.
 
 
 
• **Kanpur**
 
 
• It is on the right bank of the Ganga River.
 
• It is also known as **Manchester of the East**. ​
 
• It is the most important industrial center in Uttar Pradesh.
